item.title: Yoyogi Park — Guide
item.description: Yoyogi Park, next to Harajuku and the Meiji Shrine forest, is one of Tokyo’s largest and most popular parks, and a wonderful place to see everyday Tokyo life at play. Once an Olympic Village site for the 1964 Games, it’s now a broad, open expanse of spacious lawns, wooded groves, ponds and fountains, hugely popular on weekends when locals come to picnic, jog, cycle, practise music and dance, walk their dogs and simply relax.
